intro: Cookie is an elite murloc serving as the ship's cook aboard the juggernaut hidden deep within the Deadmines. An unusual recruit among the Defias Brotherhood, he tends the crew's cauldrons beneath the watchful eye of Captain Greenskin and Edwin VanCleef. He is the only entirely optional boss encountered within the underground dry dock.

p: Beneath the decks of the towering juggernaut in the Ironclad Cove, cooking duty falls neither to a human outrider nor a goblin engineer, but to a solitary murloc known simply as Cookie. How he came by the position is anyone's guess. Whatever doubts the rest of the crew might harbor about a murloc presiding over their rations, pirates are rarely in a position to be picky, and in the underworld of Moonbrook, a meal is a meal.

Cookie patrols the waterways and shores around the pirate flagship, wielding his cooking utensils alongside acidic brews. Despite being isolated from typical murloc tribes, he defends his cauldron with savage ferocity, flinging caustic concoctions at any intruders who wander into the docks. Because his station sits away from the main gangplanks, many who storm the cove bypass his kitchen entirely, making him the only optional overseer aboard the Defias juggernaut.
